sealed: audit outputs live only in testbed_v3/audit_t4/; nothing is written into t4_blind_identity/ or any blind package; not to be shared with blind sessions

true_state.complete_if: typed shape label L (distance < 0.4) AND orbit-complete AND one component (24-cell organisms only)

true_switch: mean rho of the dish crosses 1/2 and ends (last 20 % of frames) on the other side; time = first crossing; reporter flip = first frame the mean reporter level on the other body row exceeds that on the starting row
body_frame: e1 = head->tail = R(true alignment) (1,0); e2 = +y of the template = structural limb side = R (0,1); alignment by proper Procrustes of true positions on the template places assigned by argmax place belief
column_map_unsealed: package column j shows hidden quantity col_perm[j] of [c0 c1 c2 c3 dA dB e]
twin_drift_ood: analyst label -1 at the last frame of a twin/sham/untreated_control run
